title: Personal Loans AutoPay Discount Step for a Credit Builder Account
content:
## Rule

A Credit Builder AutoPay discount step applies to a Personal Loans AutoPay enrollment: for that AutoPay discount step, a Credit Builder account of the borrower in matured status adds 0.1 point; with no matured one, a Credit Builder account in active status with an amount past due of 0.00 adds 0.05 point; a borrower with neither adds no step. Any one account meeting a tier's terms is enough for that tier. A borrower holds at most one Credit Builder account in active status, and its amount past due is compared as an amount, so 0, 0.0 and 0.00 are all nothing past due.

The accounts are the borrower's Credit Builder Accounts, read from the borrower's Credit Builder records.

A step is added to the AutoPay discount by which the loan's base interest rate is reduced from the enrollment date; the rate is rounded to two decimals once, at the end.

| Borrower's Credit Builder Accounts | Step |
|---|---|
| at least one matured | 0.10 point |
| none matured; an active account with nothing past due | 0.05 point |
| none matured; the active account has an amount past due | none |
| none, or only accounts closed or cancelled | none |
